text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text:
Gideon, you first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug in this channel. You said both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.

The guard spent the outage logging trailer numbers by hand on a clipboard. Mateo said six trucks were waiting at the east gate by 10:44.

Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03, when the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it. You confirmed both lanes working at 11:07. That makes the outage about 25 minutes from your first report.

text: And mine: which ticket holds the status-page screenshot for Mateo's access problem?
reply_text: Ruth, the status-page screenshot is attached to ticket INC-4821. Gideon said so in this channel on 3 Aug at 11:08 AM. It covers the status-page access problem for Mateo's account. I only read the channel message. I haven't opened the ticket, so I can't confirm the screenshot is on it.
